settings.question: Can I use Smile with this page?
settings.answer: Yes. The page can explain your loyalty proposition and link into Smile, while Smile manages member accounts, balances and rewards.

settings.question: Can I show example points and rewards?
settings.answer: Yes. The companion rewards template includes editable examples. Keep them labelled as illustrative until they match the rules configured in your loyalty app.

settings.question: Can the programme match my brand?
settings.answer: Yes. The theme controls the story, imagery and page styling; your loyalty app provides the live member experience and its own appearance controls.
